subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. 

Enumerate
solution: TB Solution: The correct answer is List. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ __ • **Enumerate** means **to name a list of things separately, one by one (गणन करना, एक-एक कर वस्‍तुओं का नाम बताना)** -Example: We may now** enumerate **these various large groups in tabular form. • Marked option **List** means **a series of names, figures, items, etc. that are written, printed or said one after another. (सूची, तालिका)** -Example: He gave me a **list** of their forthcoming books. • So it is clear that **Enumerate** and List. are similar in meaning. ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** ** • Subtract** means to take a number or amount away from another number or amount. ** • ****Recite** means to say aloud a piece of writing, especially a poem or a list, from memory. ** •** **Guess** means to try to give an answer or make a judgement about something without being sure of all the facts. f1:Tf42, TB Solution:
